purpose: Converts embedded emissions into a CBAM certificate liability: applies the CBAM factor (free-allocation phase-out 2.5% 2026 to 100% 2034), deducts origin carbon price already paid, and projects the quarterly holding and surrender schedule to the 30 Sep deadline.
